bounds.scope: Realign Wrench to a Layer 1 hybrid context runtime and frozen Qwen + Wrench-Core LoRA + Continuous LoRA. Preserve v1 evidence, document owner-reported filesystem corruption/data loss without inventing its cause, clean current guidance, define the full v2 experiment, and verify repository consistency. Implementation and training stages are planned; this contract covers the direction/cleanup task.
permissions: read repository source/docs and supplied design notes
research public primary-source documentation and model metadata
run bounded offline verification and local documentation builds after storage admission
prohibited_actions: publish or deploy without applicable human authority
transfer v1 corpus or canary spend allowances to v2
upload private user data or train on sealed evaluation material
delete user data, another task artifact or sole known-good checkpoint
train, download model weights or run model inference as part of this direction cleanup
claim v2 implemented or useful based on design, synthetic passes or metadata
data_access: client receipts that contain no credentials or unrestricted private data
bounds.historical_authorization_record: docs/archive/2026-09-23-v1/COLLABORATION_CONTRACT.v1.json; old scoped approvals do not authorize v2 spending

evidence_required: both owner notes preserved and hash-checked
v1 incident report separates owner account from verified technical cause
complete v2 architecture, continual adapter lifecycle and staged experiment
current navigation and parent authority reconciled
historical receipts and unrelated edits preserved
strict storage ceiling and current inventory
git diff --check and applicable offline checks
independent review and repaired material findings

rollback.procedure: Restore direction from exact v1 snapshots if the owner requests reversal; use Git for moved source paths; preserve user edits and historical evidence. No running model/adapter state is changed by this task.
